# Nelson Frank — Fullstack Software Developer

Nelson Frank is a fullstack software developer interested in tech and building robust software using modern technologies like React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

## Core Profile
- **Website URL**: https://nelsonfrank.dev
- **Main Stack**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, GSAP, D3.js.
- **Interests**: Clean code, design systems, performance optimization, and robust web applications.
